facts.text: Drury GO is the evolution of the College of Continuing Professional Studies (CCPS), providing tailored admissions, tuition, and evening and online schedules for adult and non-residential learners.

sources.title: FAQ's | Questions - Drury University
sources.quote: Drury GO is an evolution of CCPS. The name was changed to reflect the updated program and services offerings as we strive to continue evolving with the needs of our students.

sources.title: FAQ's | Questions - Drury University
sources.quote: Classes are offered exclusively online and in the evenings, however. Admissions, tuition, and course requirements are unique to Drury GO and are designed to support our GO students' differing needs than the residential students.
